region_slices.semantics: half-open row slices local to each named side/cap cloud

rigid_mode_vector_columns.translations: unit displacement coefficient per unit translation

limitations: At a=0.5 mm the candidate crack surface extends from x<0 to x<a. The old-tip manufactured field is exact only at a=0; the shifted case is a manual fixed-load candidate reanalysis with unknown true solution, not a committed crack state, autonomous growth result, or material qualification.

The shared cap map splits the old-tip radial coordinate at c=0.5 mm, matching the shifted trial-tip radius while keeping identical physical cap points for both a values. Inner and outer maps focus radial points around both the old traction singularity and the shifted basis singularity; finite GL4 radial and GL8/GL16 angular rules still provide no certified error bound.
Two volume theta rules provide a controlled integration comparison, not a proof of convergence.
Linear small-strain elasticity is a near-tip LEFM idealization; no finite-strain or material-core model is included.
E, nu, KIII, and all reported energies are synthetic benchmark quantities, not ceramic material calibration.
